name: Muha Meds | 1g 510 Cartridge | Godfather OG
description: Godfather OG may carry a heavyweight name, but this sativa leans into uplifting, energetic effects with a fruity twist. Its flavor profile combines sweet fruit with subtle herbal notes, creating a smooth and satisfying inhale. The high is tingly and cerebral, sparking focus and motivation while keeping the mood light. Godfather OG is a solid choice for those who want both power and positivity in their session.
